<p class="back"><a href="../../en/guides/">← All guides</a></p>
<article class="doc"><h1>Final bosses: Eternatus and the Judgment of Arceus</h1><p class="lead">Every run has two fixed final bosses, in any mode, solo or in a group: <b>Eternamax Eternatus at minute 20</b>, who can be beaten and gives you
a <a href="../../en/powers/">power</a>, and <b>the Judgment of Arceus at minute 30</b>, which can't be won: what counts is how long you last and how much damage you deal.</p>
<div class="tip"><b>Before they arrive:</b> whatever is on the ground (experience, coins, heals) disappears when you travel to their arena. Pick it up first!</div>
<h2><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/crown.svg" alt="" width="28" height="28"> Calendar bosses</h2>
<p>At minutes <b>2, 6, 10, 14 and 18</b> a strong (non-legendary) Pokémon shows up, tougher each time. It attacks with ground warnings and gets enraged at half HP.
It always drops an <a href="../../en/items/">item</a>, and a ×10 ticket 1 in 3 times. Rift legendaries have <a href="../../en/legendaries/">their own guide</a>.</p>
<h2><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/crown.svg" alt="" width="28" height="28"> Eternamax Eternatus · minute 20</h2>
<ul><li>You travel to the <b>Top of the Tower</b>. It's huge and there's no time limit, but after 5 minutes of fighting it <b>goes fully enraged</b>.</li>
<li>It can't be one-shot: a hit takes at most 10 % and phases can't be skipped.</li>
<li>Its attacks take a percentage of your HP; <b>none takes more than 30 %</b>. Protect, Sturdy and Focus Sash do work against it.</li></ul>
<div class="tablewrap"><table class="list"><thead><tr><th>Phase</th><th>HP</th><th>What it does</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><b>Awakening</b></td><td>100 → 66 %</td><td>Infinite Beam (a sweep of beams), Sludge Bomb (Toxic puddles), Dynamax Energy (rings of orbs) and Dragon Pulse if you are close</td></tr><tr><td><b>Dynamax Shield</b></td><td>66 → 33 %</td><td>4 <b>Dynamax Cores</b> make it immune: break them (each drops a heal). Lasers switch on and off, and red clouds close in the arena</td></tr><tr><td><b>Enraged</b></td><td>33 → 10 %</td><td>Infinite Spiral, Dark Night (find one of the 3 safe circles), double Infinite Beam and the Vortex that pulls you in: run against it</td></tr><tr><td><b>Eternamax Beam</b></td><td>10 %</td><td>It charges for 8 s: break the <b>Eternal Core</b> and it stays stunned for 6 s taking 50 % more. If not, get into one of the two circles</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p><b>If you win:</b> +1 ×10 ticket, +600 Pokécoins, its boss loot and you pick your <a href="../../en/powers/">power</a>. Beating it on Normal unlocks <b>Hard</b>, and on Hard,
<b>Nightmare</b>. <b>If you fall</b> playing solo, the run ends (in a group you can revive each other).</p>
<h2><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/crown.svg" alt="" width="28" height="28"> The Judgment of Arceus · minute 30</h2>
<ul><li>You travel to the <b>Hall of Origin</b>. <b>Arceus is invincible</b>: the run ends when you fall (in a group, when everyone falls).</li>
<li>It holds a random Plate that gives it its type. It only takes part of your damage, less and less, and hitting it doesn't heal you.</li>
<li>It chases you faster and faster: it matches your speed after the first minute, by 3 minutes it's faster than you and at 10 it runs at 140 % of your speed. Touching it takes 45 % of your HP, and from 10 minutes it's a KO.</li>
<li>Everything it does is “pure”: it ignores types and defenses, and <b>Protect, Sturdy and Focus Sash don't work</b>.</li></ul>
<div class="tablewrap"><table class="list"><thead><tr><th>Attack</th><th>From</th><th>What it does</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Judgment</td><td>0:00</td><td>Pillars of light on everyone: step out of the circles</td></tr><tr><td>Holy Cross</td><td>0:00</td><td>Cross-shaped beams to the edge (8 from 0:30)</td></tr><tr><td>Divine Wave</td><td>0:00</td><td>A wave around it if you stand right next to it</td></tr><tr><td>Extreme Speed</td><td>0:30</td><td>Marks a lane and dashes across it like lightning</td></tr><tr><td>Future Sight</td><td>1:00</td><td>Explodes where you just were: don't retrace your steps</td></tr><tr><td>Gravity</td><td>1:30</td><td>For 4 s you move at 60 % speed and can't dash</td></tr><tr><td>Hyper Beam</td><td>2:00</td><td>16 beams sweeping a quarter of the arena</td></tr><tr><td>Plate Judgment</td><td>2:30</td><td>The 17 Plates spin and fire bullets of every type</td></tr><tr><td>Golden Wheels</td><td>5:00</td><td>Its golden wheels race around a lane near the edge, for good; at 7:00, another one further in, the other way. Cross through the gaps (they take 35 % and knock you out of the lane)</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<div class="cards2">
<div><h3>No running away</h3><p>If you get far, it appears in front of you (a golden seal warns you), and also every ~20 s. If it jumps at you 3 times in 45 s, <b>it breaks the move
you flee with</b> (Quick Attack, dashes, Agility…).</p></div>
<div><h3>Broken items</h3><p>At <b>2, 4 and 6 minutes</b> (and at 8, if you hold a fourth) it breaks one of your items. Those that give Pokécoins (Amulet Coin, Exp. Charm, Luck Incense) still pay out at the end.</p></div>
<div><h3>The floor breaks</h3><p>From the first seconds, every 4 s a chunk fills with cracks of light and falls into the clouds, up to 30 % of the floor. Standing on it hurts.</p></div>
<div><h3>In co-op: second fall, judged</h3><p>The first time you fall you can be revived. If you fall again, Arceus stops and <b>judges you</b>: you won't come back in that Judgment.</p></div>
</div>
<p><b>Ranking:</b> it counts <b>time survived</b> and <b>damage to Arceus</b>. Reaching 10 minutes of Judgment (≈ 40:00 into the run) is the stuff of legends.
At Halloween, the great witch Gengar takes Arceus's place.</p><p class="cta"><a class="btn" href="../../en/">Play free</a></p></article>
